label: Initial typed frontend API client
instruction: Generate a compact TypeScript api.ts file for the ELM React module (max110 lines). Import http from ../../../lib/http. Export interfaces LeaveApplication, LeaveBalance, LeaveTask, Configuration and NewApplication, plus async functions listApplications(), listBalances(), listTasks(), submitApplication(data: NewApplication), applicationAction(id:number, action:string, data:Record<string,unknown>), getConfiguration(), saveConfiguration(data:Configuration), getRecords(). Existing API routes use /leave/applications etc and return bare arrays. Match existing generated model fields; no new dependencies, no fetch or custom auth. NewApplication has leave_type:number,start_date:string,end_date:string,purpose:string. Keep response types explicit for TypeScript. Configuration shape policy and calendar can use Record<string,unknown> arrays as needed. Use supplied API shapes, do not fix backend logic.
